verdict.rationale: BILL documents several configurable background automations. These include vendor autopay, which pays automatically when a bill is created; recurring bill templates; an AI Invoice Coding Agent for automatic multi-line coding; automatic 2/3-way matching; and AI spend management that categorizes transactions and keeps them compliant automatically. However, these are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a user-defined automation or agent builder, and most are on the AP side rather than Spend & Expense. Webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/workflow builder, S&E-specific autonomous agent workflows, detail on how autonomous AI actions are configured and monitored, independent or hands-on corroboration.
